department: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering

deadline.value: Fall 2027 deadline for full TA/RA funding consideration is January 15, 2027; final Fall admission deadline is March 15, 2027 (Spring: August 15 TA/RA, October 15 final).
deadline.quote: Fall admission: January 15 for full consideration of TA and RA positions (Applications accepted until March 15)

also.quote: Fall 2027: March 15, 2027 (TA and RA apps: January 15, 2027)

gre_general.value: GRE General is required for all international applicants and for graduates of foreign universities (waived only for domestic ABET ME/AE graduates meeting GPA criteria).
gre_general.quote: GRE: Required for ALL international applicants. Required for domestic applicants if GPA < 3.3 OR if undergraduate degree is not in aerospace or mechanical engineering from an ABET-accredited program.

also.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are not required except in the following cases: Failure to meet the GPA requirement | Previous degree from a foreign university

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students formally select their MAE dissertation advisor after passing the qualifying examination; however, applicants are asked in their goal statement to name a faculty member from the MAE directory and explain research fit.
supervisor.quote: Once the qualifying exam has been successfully completed, the dissertation committee will be formed. The student will select a dissertation advisor from the MAE faculty.

also.quote: Also include in your goal statement the faculty member's name that you selected on the previous page and describe why you feel they would be a good fit for you as your advisor.

funding.value: Teaching and research assistantships require applying by the January 15 priority deadline for full consideration (not guaranteed), alongside competitive Graduate School PhD Grants (up to $26,000/yr) and Tuition Matching Grants (up to $8,000/yr).
funding.quote: Fall admission: January 15 for full consideration of TA and RA positions

also.quote: Awards in any amount of up to $26,000 per year, or $13,000 per semester, may be processed by the Office of Financial Aid. | Resident and nonresident graduate students, including international students, are eligible for this grant.

entry_route.value: Admits students with either a Bachelor of Science or Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related field with >= 3.3 GPA (BS entrants must also satisfy MS admission prerequisites; up to 21 MS credits transferable, or 24 with waiver).
entry_route.quote: Bachelor of Science or Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or closely related field with a GPA of 3.3/4.0 on all previous college work. BS students must also satisfy all admission requirements for the Master of Science.

notes: Graduate School table sets 4.5 TOEFL iBT on the post-1/21/2026 scale (legacy 80 iBT / IELTS 6.5 also shown on MAE application page). Program requires 30 coursework + 30 dissertation credits; qualifying exam covers Thermal and Fluid Systems, Solid Mechanics/Structures/Materials, or Dynamics and Controls after one academic semester.
name: Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering, Ph.D.
